 Singlife Account to be Closed From 16th December 2027
 Updated 17th November 2026 
 Seth 
 In an email to Singlife Account users, Singlife has announced the sunsetting of Singlife Account, with all accounts to be closed by 16th December 2027. 
 From 16th December 2026, transfers to PayNow UEN will no longer be possible. Users with at least S$100 in their accounts will be able to continue using their Singlife Account until 16th December 2027, after which their accounts will be closed. 
 Application of the product has now been closed, and all promotional and bonus returns campaigns will cease from 16th December 2026.
 Users with less than S$100 will see earlier closure of their accounts
 Singlife Account requires users to maintain at least S$100 to earn returns on their balance amounts. With this announcement, accounts with a balance of S$100 or less for more than 120 days will now be closed the following month.
 Your Account Value What This Means When your Singlife Account will close 
 Your Singlife Account has remained below the minimum Account Value of S$100 for more than 120 days. Your policy coverage has lapsed, and your Singlife Account will close. The following month
 You have maintained an Account Value of S$100 or more in your Singlife Account. Your policy coverage will continue, and your Singlife Account will remain open. 16th December 2027 
 Singlife also states that you can close your account earlier by withdrawing all your funds.

 What happens upon account closure?
 Singlife states that any remaining account balance and any interest earned will be returned to a user’s linked bank account upon account closure. 
 Users should ensure that a valid bank account is linked by 1st December 2026. This can be done so by tapping “Withdraw” on the Singlife Account dashboard in the Singlife App, followed by “Link bank account”. 
 Transfers to PayNow UEN and bonus returns will cease from 16th December 2026
 Users will no longer be able to make payments to PayNow UEN from 16th December 2026. Top-ups and withdrawals will still be possible as long as their accounts remain open. 
 All promotional and bonus campaign returns such as those from Singlife Booster Bonus Campaign and Singlife Account Top-up Campaign will cease from 16th December 2026.
 Only the base interest of 1.5% p.a. on the first S$10,000 and 1% p.a. for amounts above S$10,000 up to S$100,000 will continue. 
 Alternatives?
 Singlife Account has been an interesting product since its inception in late 2019. Even though it is technically an insurance policy, it acts much like a savings account, giving users liquidity of their funds. 
 Over time, however, its rates have not kept up with its competition, and the product was largely left to wither after the departure of Singlife’s ex-CEO and founder of the company (who went to found Chocolate Finance which is another not-a-bank-account product that emulates the features of a bank account). 
 Few would perhaps miss this product, but if you do have some funds in the account this could be a timely reminder to start looking for a new home for those savings:
